meta.name: detecting-data-and-model-poisoning
meta.description: Identify poisoned training data and backdoored models across the ML pipeline.

copy.tagline: 检测机器学习流水线中的投毒数据和后门模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保训练数据和模型未被恶意篡改。
copy.tagline_en: Detect poisoned data and backdoored models in ML pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure training data and models are not tampered with.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能检查训练数据和模型是否被投毒或植入后门。它会验证数据来源、检测异常标签、分析模型内部激活模式，并测试模型是否对特定触发器产生异常输出。
howto.when: 当你使用第三方或用户贡献的数据训练模型，或部署从网上下载的预训练模型时触发。也可在 CI/CD 流程中自动扫描数据集和模型文件。

say.text: 检查这个数据集有没有被投毒。
测试这个模型有没有后门触发器。
say.note: Claude 会尝试触发并计算攻击成功率。

say.text: 验证这个模型文件的哈希值和格式是否安全。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can check if training data or models have been poisoned or backdoored. It verifies data provenance, detects anomalous labels, analyzes internal model activations, and tests whether the model produces abnormal outputs for specific triggers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you train a model on third-party or user-contributed data, or deploy a pre-trained model downloaded from the internet. Also usable as a CI/CD gate to scan datasets and model artifacts.

say_en.note: Claude will run Cleanlab and ART to detect anomalous samples.

say_en.text: Test this model for backdoor triggers.
say_en.note: Claude will attempt to trigger and compute attack success rate.

say_en.text: Verify the hash and format of this model file.
say_en.note: Claude will check SHA-256 and recommend safetensors format.
